svg.title: airgap-architect in a terminal
svg.desc: The four scripts of the airgap-architect skill run on a department blueprint: tier.py, size.py, manifest.py and lint.py. Lint ends with OK: no findings. The output is the scripts' real output, rebuilt by design/demo/build_demo.py.
